parsed.rationale: Both records reside in the same package ('Playback') and the same directory ('Shared/Playback/Sources/RadioPlayer/Player/'), with one being a type-alias-object in 'RadioPlayer.swift' and the other an extension in 'RadioPlayer+AudioPlayerProtocol.swift'. This is the standard Swift pattern of splitting a type's definition from its protocol conformance extensions across sibling files — the name collision is intentional and idiomatic, not a duplication problem. Neither record carries any fields or signatures, and all structural evidence fields (jaccard, shared_field_count, etc.) are null, providing no actionable duplication signal.
